title: VLAN Trunk Allowed-List Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose and resolve multi-VLAN trunking failures across an enterprise dual-switch infrastructure. Investigate trunk allowed list omissions, identify and align native VLAN mismatches, and verify end-to-end Layer 2 trunk transport without impacting existing operational VLANs or unrelated access ports.
learning_objectives: Diagnose IEEE 802.1Q trunking anomalies using Cisco IOS diagnostic commands (show interfaces trunk, show interfaces switchport)
Identify trunk allowed-list omissions that prevent specific VLAN traffic from traversing inter-switch links
Detect and resolve Native VLAN mismatch conditions between adjacent trunk peers
Safely modify trunk allowed VLAN lists using add and remove modifiers without overwriting existing allowed VLANs
Verify end-to-end intra-VLAN reachability across trunks while preserving strict Layer 2 broadcast domain isolation between distinct VLANs

source.origin: Independently authored enterprise switching laboratory guide based on IEEE 802.1Q standards and Cisco IOS Layer 2 trunk troubleshooting best practices
